meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后, Claude 会使用 `dial` 命令发短信、拨打 AI 语音电话、接收验证码;遇到没见过的子命令时,会先查看其帮助或官方文档再操作。
howto.when: 当用户提到“短信”、“电话”、“验证码”等关键词,或提出打电话、发短信、接收验证码等请求时;也用于首次运行 `dial` 命令前或探索 Dial 平台能做什么时。

say.text: 给 +14155550123 发短信,内容是‘明天下午三点见’。
say.note: 会执行 dial message 发送短信。

say.text: 拨打 +14155550123,让 AI 接通后说‘您好,这里是客服’。
say.note: 会发起 dial call 语音电话。

say.text: 帮我等待一条来自该号码的短信验证码并告诉我正文。
say.note: 会运行 dial wait-for 解析消息。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can use the dial CLI to send SMS, place AI voice calls, receive inbound texts/codes, and check command help or docs before using an unfamiliar subcommand.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions SMS, calls, or verification codes, or asks to text, call, or wait for a code; also before first use of a dial command or when exploring Dial capabilities.

say_en.text: Send an SMS to +14155550123 with the body 'See you tomorrow at 3pm'.
Call +14155550123 and have the AI agent say 'Hello, this is support' when connected.
say_en.note: Places a voice call via dial call.

say_en.text: Wait for an SMS verification code from that number and tell me the body.
say_en.note: Runs dial wait-for and parses the message.
